mcq_drop.why: ambiguous stem (which fort?) with throwaway options; better covered by nff8536e6e25

patterns: APPSC asks single facts: Blue Water Policy = Portuguese / Almeida (G2 2023, 2025 twice); EIC formed 1600; charter gave exclusive trading rights; first factory at Machilipatnam = Portuguese (G2 2019 key).

Other PSCs favour order of arrival (Portuguese, Dutch, English, French), first Portuguese fort (Cochin), real founder (Albuquerque), Swally (Thomas Best), first English factory Surat 1613, Bombay from Portuguese.
Statement-not-correct items with date traps (Goa 1510 not 1499) recur in UPSC.
App covers these thoroughly with good AP tilt (Masulipatnam, Pulicat, Golden Farman); a few items are interpretive ('best explains British success').
